caption: The video captures a sunny beach scene where soap bubbles drift across a fixed frame. Rippled sand with footprints leads to calm water on the left, a tree-covered headland on the right, and a bright sun flare in the sky. A distant person stands near the waterline with arms raised, holding a thin line, amid sparkling bubbles. Large iridescent bubbles move close to the camera, drifting rightward and upward before leaving the view. A dome-shaped bubble rests near the sand in the middle distance and shifts gradually to the right. A large translucent bubble appears on the left and remains suspended above the sea and shore. The fine field of tiny bubbles keeps shifting position and density, so the flow is ongoing throughout the visible excerpt.
